mapper.select: SELECT id, total_saved_carbon_kg AS totalSavedCarbonKg, total_saved_power_kwh AS totalSavedPowerKwh, total_saved_cost_krw AS totalSavedCostKrw, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM infra_esg_cumulative_metric LIMIT 1

SELECT id, log_date AS logDate, log_hour AS logHour, traditional_estimated_cpu_util AS traditionalEstimatedCpuUtil, optimized_actual_cpu_util AS optimizedActualCpuUtil, power_consumption_kw AS powerConsumptionKw, created_at AS createdAt FROM infra_power_hourly_log WHERE log_date = #{logDate} ORDER BY log_hour ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO infra_power_hourly_log ( log_date, log_hour, traditional_estimated_cpu_util, optimized_actual_cpu_util, power_consumption_kw, created_at ) VALUES
( #{log.logDate}, #{log.logHour}, #{log.traditionalEstimatedCpuUtil}, #{log.optimizedActualCpuUtil}, #{log.powerConsumptionKw}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO infra_esg_cumulative_metric ( id, total_saved_carbon_kg, total_saved_power_kwh, total_saved_cost_krw, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{carbon}, #{power}, #{cost}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_saved_carbon_kg = total_saved_carbon_kg + #{carbon}, total_saved_power_kwh = total_saved_power_kwh + #{power}, total_saved_cost_krw = total_saved_cost_krw + #{cost}, updated_at = NOW()
